settings.title: Settings and look
settings.description: How your booking page and your customers’ tickets look, and how people can pay.
settings.errName: Enter your business name, as customers see it.
settings.saved: Settings saved. Customers see the new look straight away.
settings.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can change the settings.
settings.businessNameHint: Shown on the booking page, on tickets and in messages to customers.
settings.colorDescription: For buttons and links on the booking page and on tickets. Text adjusts its shade automatically so it stays easy to read.
settings.payOnSiteHelp: Affiliates can make bookings that the customer pays to you when they board. The amount to collect appears when you scan the ticket. Without this option, all bookings are paid online.
settings.attributionHint: If a customer opens an affiliate’s link and books within this time, the booking belongs to the affiliate. Usually: 30 days.
settings.logoHelp: A wide logo on a transparent background (PNG or SVG) looks best. We shrink it automatically.
settings.logoErrUpload: We could not upload the image.
settings.logoErrRead: We could not read the image. Try a PNG or JPG file.
settings.logoErrSize: The image has no dimensions. Try another file.
settings.logoErrCanvas: Your browser cannot process the image.
settings.logoErrComplex: The image is too complex. Try a simpler version of the logo.
settings.lightColorNote: Light colour: buttons keep it, and links use a darker shade.
settings.previewSr: Preview: the booking page and the ticket, with the chosen name, logo and colour.
